meta.scope: Afghanistan Batch 2 — Agriculture (wheat), humanitarian needs / poverty, and remittances densification under highly constrained conditions.

candidates.title: Agriculture production statistics
candidates.publisher: Ministry of Agriculture, Irrigation and Livestock / NSIA related
candidates.description: Statistics on crop and livestock production. Agriculture is the backbone of rural livelihoods and food security; wheat is the dominant staple. Production is highly sensitive to drought, water availability and input constraints.
candidates.notes: Core primary-sector production node under constrained conditions.

candidates.title: Wheat production and food-gap statistics
candidates.description: Focused statistics on wheat production and the structural wheat gap. Domestic production typically falls short of national demand (around 4.5–5 million tonnes vs demand near 7 million tonnes), making imports and humanitarian food assistance critical.
candidates.notes: Foundational food-security crop node. Structural production deficit is a defining feature.

candidates.title: Humanitarian needs and acute food insecurity statistics
candidates.publisher: OCHA / Humanitarian Needs and Response Plan / IPC-aligned
candidates.description: Statistics on people in need of humanitarian assistance and acute food insecurity. In 2026 an estimated 21.9 million people (roughly 45% of the population) require humanitarian assistance; acute food insecurity affects over 17 million, with several million in Emergency (IPC Phase 4).
candidates.notes: Highest-centrality social and humanitarian node under current conditions.

candidates.title: Remittance inflows framing
candidates.publisher: Derived from World Bank and related sources
candidates.description: Framing of remittance inflows as a critical external financing and household-income source. Remittances support consumption and foreign-exchange availability under constrained formal capital flows.

candidates.title: Afghanistan agriculture–humanitarian–remittances densification meta-node
candidates.publisher: Derived from MAIL, OCHA and external sources
candidates.description: Meta-node binding agriculture and wheat statistics, humanitarian needs / acute food insecurity, and remittance inflows into a coherent primary-sector, humanitarian and external-financing layer under highly constrained conditions.
